Referred Sections: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF)

Required findings: Procedure performed for one of the specified clinical conditions (as defined in the full policy) with all associated criteria met

Non-Indications: ACDF performed without meeting the specified clinical conditions or associated criteria
Important criteria & exceptions: Determination of medical necessity is made on a case‑by‑case basis per General Guidelines (CMM-601.1)
Documentation required: Clinical documentation demonstrating the indication and that all required criteria have been satisfied
